svg.title: Anaesthetist — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as anaesthetist, wearing scrubs and a surgical cap. Visible work cue: A tapered anaesthetic breathing mask has a central connector and a curved breathing hose. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a surgical cap and round glasses.
